scope: Read-only semantic retirement review of historical PRs #3, #4 and #62; no remote mutations, no new workload/test execution, no TODO credit.

current_main.message:
docs(p8): preserve original acceptance and regression evidence (#171)

Merge the independently reviewed artifact-only archive. Preserve all existing main paths and the original A23, failure, cancelled-run and Mac regression identities. Original scale remains incomplete; canonical TODO status is unchanged. This merge records byte custody and does not claim CI, Mac workspace, full-scale or release acceptance.

decisions.original_intent: Hard caller scope separate from heuristic preselection; reliable non-embedding retrieval/indexing; long-symbol projection; replayable independent quality evidence.

covered_examples.capability: Monotonic bounded BM25 bonus and one vote per retrieval lane
Immutable AnalysisInputs and retained parser-exact reload policy

unique_or_unresolved.contract: Old graph projection returns every intersecting chunk when no chunk contains the entire symbol.
unique_or_unresolved.assessment: Current main deliberately uses one byte-verified declaration anchor per symbol and explicitly does not claim the whole body was returned. This covers split-symbol discovery through a different contract, but it does not implement the old all-intersections result set. Treat as an unresolved adoption/retirement decision, not evidence that main is broken.
unique_or_unresolved.next_action: Either explicitly retire the all-body-chunks promise in favor of the current declaration-anchor contract, or open a narrow modern follow-up with the old split-boundary cases; do not reverse-merge the old branch.

unique_or_unresolved.contract: Old replay scorer has a named AND-of-OR evidence_sufficient boolean across required_groups.
unique_or_unresolved.assessment: Main has answer-group recall, alternatives, no-answer handling and a separate marker-based facet-coverage suite. Those are real successor capabilities, but this inspection does not establish equivalence to the old required_groups boolean and its historical replay population. File absence alone is not the reason for retention.
unique_or_unresolved.next_action: Map or explicitly retire the old required-groups regression contract in the current scorer before claiming full semantic adoption.

decisions.merge_advice: Keep as a historical source of the remaining contract decisions, or replace it with an explicit scoped successor before closing. No recommendation to merge this obsolete whole branch.
decisions.not_required: The unrelated original 150-shard scale study is not a retirement prerequisite.

decisions.original_intent: AST-backed JS/TS/Python facts, dependency-correct incremental invalidation, explicit graph/lane ablation and structured evidence diagnostics. This PR is stacked on #3 and only its additional scope is evaluated.

covered_examples.capability: AST truth regressions reject declarations/comments/string bodies as calls and preserve nested ownership/recursion/shadowing distinctions.
Separate persisted resolution dependencies and transaction-coupled replacement

unique_or_unresolved.contract: graph_features=false disables graph preselection, lane, reranking and enrichment.
unique_or_unresolved.assessment: The old ADR and code define one end-to-end graph ablation control. Targeted main search did not find graph_features or a named equivalent all-graph disable control in the relevant config/search/server paths. Existing separate ablation/strategy tests are not automatically equivalent.
unique_or_unresolved.next_action: Design/map a complete graph-feature ablation against current architecture or explicitly retire the old config promise; retain this obligation until the decision is recorded.

unique_or_unresolved.contract: A zero lane weight suppresses candidate production.
unique_or_unresolved.assessment: There is an explicit semantic disagreement: old grep eligibility requires grep_weight > 0, while current main documents eligibility independent of fusion weight and permits legacy grep candidates with zero RRF weight. This is not a path-renaming issue and is not, by itself, a main bug.
unique_or_unresolved.next_action: Make a deliberate lane-control contract decision and preserve a narrow regression for the chosen behavior instead of merging the obsolete schema-8 branch.

decisions.merge_advice: Keep pending a narrow successor/disposition for graph ablation and lane execution semantics. Most AST/dependency ideas have evolved in main; do not restore the entire old schema/implementation.

decisions.original_intent: The first 20-family Express author candidate checkpoint before common-protocol migration; not independent acceptance or a clean holdout corpus.

successor.reason: Both current PR bodies expressly designate #68 as the authoritative 100-draft successor and state the first 20 are included rather than additive.

covered_examples.capability: Identical seven Express handwritten source files and identical MIT license are retained by the current reviewed DEV source snapshot.
The common-protocol public projection of the first 20 is present in current main: 12 native DEV IDs / 9 compat DEV IDs.

remaining_obligations: The other eight first-block candidates were classified as would-be holdout and isolated; no claim that all 20 were independently accepted.
The old initial 14 DEV / 6 holdout split is not the adopted common protocol; do not merge it back.
Public exposure, component review and custody remain tracked by #68 and main corpus-lock/final-acceptance records. Closing #62 does not close #68, V19 or P8-002/003/004.
Current main has 70 native / 59 compat Express DEV rows; the successor body's historical 68 / 57 counts describe its own author checkpoint and are not current-main totals.
decisions.preservation: Close without deleting the branch, rewriting head 336b962ffe7cb5d144273cfc2f45b0526ecba8bc, squashing or removing historical exposure/hash evidence.
decisions.suggested_close_reason: This first-20 Express author checkpoint is superseded by #68. Main retains the identical seven-source-file MIT snapshot and the migrated first-block public DEV projection (12 native / 9 compat). The eight would-be holdout candidates and public-history custody limits remain unresolved in the successor/corpus records; this closure does not certify clean holdout or V19 completion.
decisions.not_required: No performance measurement or original 150-shard completion prerequisite.

limitations: This is a source/metadata review, not a new execution claim.
Existing historical run claims are preserved as historical and were not rerun.
Only public DEV metadata was used for ID coverage; no protected heldout question/gold bodies were inspected or copied into this report.
Nonempty diffs and absent old filenames are not treated as sufficient proof of nonadoption.
Current source, CI, measurements, canonical TODO ledger and remote PR state were not changed.
